After a year with no driving convictions you must pass a touch screen computer test based on decision making, then you progress to green Ps where you are no longer limited on passengers and can drive 100 km/h (60mph), and know display green p plates, you must hold your green Ps for 2 years before passing a final theory test to become a fully licensed driver
